verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents webhooks emitted on invoice workflow transitions [docs-12], and payment failures on invoices trigger automatic retries and reminders [docs-13]. Invoice-level lifecycle events are therefore evidenced. However, the product is framed around one-time-payment invoices [probe-2], and nothing in the pack shows subscription-specific events. Missing for 10: evidence of webhooks for subscription renewal, upgrade, and cancellation; documentation of webhook delivery reliability (retries, signatures, ordering); independent or hands-on corroboration.
